definitions.gloss: sign; indication; first signs of something beginning
definitions.explanation: Early, often subtle indications that something is starting or about to happen.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}の{兆|きざ}しが{見|み}え{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: Signs of spring have begun to appear.

examples.japanese: {回復|かいふく}の{兆|きざ}しがある。
{不況|ふきょう}の{兆|きざ}しが{見|み}える。

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
From the verb {兆|きざ}す (to show signs of, to begin to appear)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{兆|きざ}しが{見|み}える / ある (signs are visible/present)
・{兆|きざ}しを{見|み}せる (to show signs of)
・Xの{兆|きざ}し (signs of X)
・{春|はる}の{兆|きざ}し (signs of spring)
・{回復|かいふく}の{兆|きざ}し (signs of recovery)

USAGE NOTE:
{兆|きざ}し often describes subtle, natural indicators of change, especially seasonal or gradual transitions. It carries a neutral to positive connotation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{前触|まえぶ}れ (harbinger, warning) - can be more dramatic or deliberate
・{前兆|ぜんちょう} (omen) - often for significant/dramatic events
・{兆|きざ}し - subtle, often positive or neutral early signs
